_description: H5: Shorten time stop from 15 to 10 trading days. Tests whether faster capital recycling improves returns by freeing position slots earlier. Built on baseline_v5 (H1 integrated).
_hypothesis: H5 from 16-agent analysis: positions held to the 15-day time stop often saw capital tied up with lagging returns (Jan 24, Jun 21, Jul 8/11, Sep 30, Oct 14/22 examples). Reducing to 10 days recycles capital faster for new high-conviction setups.
_baseline: Compare to h1_floor_jan_mar and h1_floor_jul_sep. Delta = H5 time stop effect only.

run.hypothesis_text: Time stop shortened: pead_max_hold_days 15 -> 10 trading days
